title: Army public affairs source terrified of the NSA

tellings.quote: this individual was in US Army Office of Public Affairs. He served in the mid2010s and he said I like I'm not really afraid of the CIA but what I'm terrified of is the NSA.

plain: A man who served in the US Army's Office of Public Affairs in the mid-2010s said he was not really afraid of the CIA, the US spy agency, but was terrified of the NSA, the agency that runs America's electronic surveillance. The online UFO researcher known as UAPGerb passes this on from the man himself, who is not named. It is told to suggest which agency insiders fear most when it comes to secrets.
